Full desktop control

It has the same functionality as a mouse, but on top of that it can additionally emit keys or launch applications using gestures.

View/manipulate 3D models

You can tailor the application to view 3D objects from different angles, switch between views/textures, or pan and zoom.

Create custom gesture applications

You can import the SDK to create applications such as touchless gesture controllers or music instrument players.

Version 0.29 demo

Full gesture control. It allows you to use your hand as a mouse substitute, send keystrokes, or even launch custom commands — such as opening a browser. It even supports two-handed control.
